scope: independent root audit of the actual top-symmetric incidence detector, exact t-avoiding singleton saturation, first quotient, bounded-degree univariate height obstruction, capacity, and zero booking

mathematical_audit.incidence: For p>A and 0<Z_j<A^2, every hit is simple. If exactly one load is hit, E=sum(P/Z_j) has exactly one p-unit summand; if at least two loads are hit, every summand is divisible by p.
mathematical_audit.saturation: With N nonzero loads, P/gcd(P,(|t|E)^N) has p-valuation one exactly for t-avoiding singleton hits. The exponent N is sufficient because v_p(P)=k_p<=N.
mathematical_audit.actual_carrier: Intersecting the large-prime radical of that saturation with Q^[1] gives the existing actual U_11 carrier exactly. Its raw height is below two beta copies, while the Q intersection still supplies only the old one-copy ceiling.
mathematical_audit.first_quotient: At a singleton hit j, (P/p)E^{-1}=Z_j/p mod p and 1<=Z_j/p<A<p. Thus P and every p-unit monomial quotient P E^r/V have valuation exactly one.
mathematical_audit.univariate_reduction: For P C(E)/V with V a p-unit, the second digit is equivalent to p dividing C(E). Positive singleton mass forces linearly many distinct hit rows and hence positive beta-scale log E.
mathematical_audit.height_no_go: For fixed positive degree and sub-beta coefficient/denominator height, leading-term dominance gives log|C(E)/D| bounded below by a positive multiple of log b. Such a residual is not sub-beta.
mathematical_audit.scope_warning: The result does not close multivariate symmetric cancellation, beta-height gcd or denominator cancellation, full-support degree-N states, or the constant/content branch.
mathematical_audit.capacity: No sub-beta actual carrier or weighted estimate is obtained, so beta capacity and booking remain unchanged.
